role.description: Optional filter — only entries with this role are returned.

scope.description: Optional filter — only entries whose scopes include this string are returned.

subjectPrefix.description: Optional filter — only entries whose subject VID starts with this prefix are returned.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of entries to return. Maintainer-defined default and ceiling.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by the maintainer in a previous response.

Response.title: ACL List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to an acl/list request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/acl/list/0.1#response.

entries.description: Matching AclEntry items, in maintainer-defined order. May be empty.

truncated.description: true when more matching entries exist beyond `entries`; false when this response is the complete result. Independent of `cursor`: a maintainer MAY truncate without supporting pagination, in which case `truncated` is true and `cursor` is absent.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token to fetch the next page. Present only when `truncated` is true AND the maintainer supports pagination from this point. Consumers MUST treat the cursor as opaque and re-send it verbatim.

redactedFields.description: Names of AclEntry fields the maintainer redacted from every returned entry (for example, ['metadata']).
